prompts.patient: Use case: scientific-educational photorealistic asset for an interactive adult nursing simulation, not a UI mockup. Create a wide image containing exactly TWO equal rectangular panels side by side, no gutter, no border, no typography. Each half shows the SAME fictitious 35-year-old Ecuadorian/Latino male patient, medium tan skin, short black hair, teal hospital gown, seated semi-upright on a clean examination bed in a contemporary modest clinic, visible from head to upper thighs including both hands and forearms. Consistent camera, lighting, pose, face and room across panels. Left panel: conscious and responsive, tired expression, one hand loosely holding lower abdomen, lips slightly dry, mild discomfort from gastroenteritis and dehydration, no tubes, no blood, no vomit, no exposed genitals. Right panel: the same man after observed care, sitting a little more comfortably, relaxed face and hands, modest improvement, not a miraculous cure. Keep head near x50 y24 percent WITHIN each panel, abdomen around x50 y65, exposed forearm around x77 y60. Natural photographic textures, accurate adult proportions, gentle daylight, cream walls, pale teal linens. Educational documentary photography appearance, high detail, realistic anatomy. No doctor or nurse, no instruments, no labels, no logos, no watermarks. Precisely two equal frames of the same patient, consistent framing suitable for CSS sprite positioning.
prompts.equipment: Use case: product-mockup clinical teaching equipment sprite atlas. A perfectly regular 3 by 3 grid of NINE equal square cells, no gutters, no outlines, no text outside objects. Photorealistic clean clinical equipment photographed separately from slightly above, each object centered entirely within its cell on the SAME light neutral white-gray studio background, soft consistent shadows. Read in rows left-to-right. Top row: (1) digital clinical thermometer with a blank display, (2) automatic upper-arm blood-pressure cuff and small monitor, (3) acoustic stethoscope with dark teal tubing. Middle row: (4) white unbranded oral rehydration salts sachet beside a clear drinking cup and a pitcher of clean water, (5) clear graduated empty measuring jug for fluid-balance training, (6) closed sterile stool sample container with red screw lid and packaged collection spoon, no contents. Bottom row: (7) closed unbranded medication package with a few blister tablets, (8) telephone/intercom handset for calling the clinical team, (9) patient education leaflet and clipboard, no readable printed text. All materials are unbranded generic props, no fake safety symbols, no patient data, no needles, no stains, no blood, no drug names. Real product photography, crisp recognizable silhouettes, equal image scale, generous margins inside each cell. Exactly 9 items/groups in a 3x3 atlas, no extra equipment, no human hands, no UI.
